name: Rally Point
author: Addicting Games
description: Rally Point is a free racing game. The best racing games get to the point, the rally point. In Rally Point you can start with one of two different cars which you will use to blast through a variety of different tracks. Earn cash to buy upgrades and unlock new cars, upgrades, and other cool touch-ups that make the game uniquely you. This is a high-quality, high-octane racer that lets you live out your wildest dreams. Race at night, through mud, on city streets, in a new car, a classic car, or a futuristic racer that you personally customize. The choice is yours and you make it with every race you win, every race you fail, and every time you turbo-charge your way to a finish flag somewhere high in the sky. You can do it. you can show them all with this game. so, sit down, strap in, and get going. Rally Point is a racing game that you will tell your grandchildren about. Rally Point is the coolest game out there and is totally one that you will be happy to play.
